definitions.content:
The accuracy classes for instruments and their symbols $ ^{*} $ are given in Table 1. Please note that the class denominations used in this Recommendation do not include the oval around the number for improved clarity of the Recommendation's text.
Table 1
NameSymbol marked on instrumentDenomination used in this Recommendation
Special accuracyⅠⅠ
High accuracyⅡⅡ
Medium accuracyⅢⅢ
Ordinary accuracyⅣⅣⅣ
* Ovals of any shape, or two horizontal lines joined by two half-circles are permitted. A circle shall not be used because, in conformity with OIML R 34 Accuracy classes of measuring instruments, it is used for the designation of accuracy classes of measuring instruments of which the maximum permissible errors are expressed by a constant relative error in %.
